title: Rule programs
description: A spec's rule checks written as data (src/rule-program.ts): the gates run each one as its rule's check, and the SDK emitters write each into every SDK, so one definition decides a rule everywhere.

defs.description: Shared definitions, by name, each an expression read on the rule owner's value.

rules.description: Each rule's program, by its ID in rules.json.

owner.description: The type whose values the rule reads, its owner in rules.json.

on.description: The type that holds the owner's values and whose value the rule reads too, as ["up"]; the places of the owner's values in it are the model's.

undecided.description: Where it holds, the rule can't decide: the holder shows too little of what the rule reads.

each.description: A list or a map: the violation applies once per item or member, binding the names `as` gives.

as.description: The names `each` binds: the index or key, then the item.

path.description: The JSON pointer of the violation below the owner's value: a pointer, or an expression that gives one, as `["pointer", ...]` does.

expr.description: A JSON literal, or an operation: an array whose first item names it (src/rule-program.ts).

anyOf.description: An operation: its name, then its arguments; the evaluator fails on a name it doesn't know.
